name: Vayne
title: the Night Hunter

Q.name: Tumble
Q.description: Vayne rolls a short distance, and deals an additional 0.75/0.85/0.95/1.05/1.15×AD + 0.5×AP physical damage on her next Attack. This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage.
Q.summary: Vayne tumbles, maneuvering to carefully place her next shot. Her next attack deals bonus damage.

W.name: Silver Bolts
W.description: Passive: Every third consecutive Attack or Ability against an enemy deals an additional 0.04/0.055/0.07/0.085/0.1 max Health true damage.
W.summary: Vayne tips her bolts with a rare metal, toxic to evil things. The third consecutive attack or ability against the same target deals a percentage of the target's max health as bonus true damage.

E.name: Condemn
E.description: Vayne fires a bolt that Knocks Back and deals 50/85/120/155/190 + 0.5×bonus AD physical damage. If the target collides with terrain, they take (50/85/120/155/190 + 0.5×bonus AD) × 1.5 bonus physical damage and become Stunned for 1.5 seconds.
E.summary: Vayne draws a heavy crossbow from her back, and fires a huge bolt at her target, knocking them back and dealing damage. If they collide with terrain, they are impaled, dealing bonus damage and stunning them.

R.name: Final Hour
R.description: Vayne gains 35/50/65 Attack Damage for 8/10/12 seconds, extended by 4 seconds whenever a champion damaged by Vayne dies within 3 seconds. Additionally, during the duration:Night Hunter instead grants 90 Move Speed.The Cooldown of Tumble is reduced by 30/40/50%, and grants Invisibility for 1 second.
R.summary: Readying herself for an epic confrontation, Vayne gains increased Attack Damage, Invisibility during Tumble, reduced Tumble cooldown, and more bonus Move Speed from Night Hunter

Passive.name: Night Hunter
Passive.description: Vayne ruthlessly hunts evil-doers, gaining Move Speed when moving toward nearby enemy champions.
Passive.summary: Vayne ruthlessly hunts evil-doers, gaining Move Speed when moving toward nearby enemy champions.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Hyper-scaling marksman who hunts tanks with W true damage every third hit. Wins fights by tumbling with Q, pinning with E stun into walls, and going invisible with R.
strengths: W true damage % max health every third hit shreds tanks
Q tumble repositions and empowers the next attack
E knocks back and stuns if the target hits terrain
R gives stealth on Q and bonus damage
weaknesses: Weak to poke and hard engage
E is her main peel; once down she's vulnerable
Falls behind if she can't farm
profile.curveNote: Needs Q, W and E; really comes online with items.

W.notes: Third hit true damage, % max health.

E.notes: Knockback; stun into terrain. Blockable by projectile blocks.

profile.windowAgainst: Early levels (weak lane) or E on cooldown: engage.
checks: Whether E knockback counts as airborne (knock-backs usually are).
